name: S-mod slot (+1)
desc: A dockyard charter stamped with the Ledger's seal. Any yard that reads it finds room for one more refit than the hull should hold.

name: D-mod removal
desc: Parts machined to tolerances nobody has used since the Collapse. Every scar on one hull, gone.

name: Stat tuning
desc: A tuning kit and a note in a hand you almost recognise: one change, and make it count.

name: Extra ordnance points
desc: Mount rails and power couplings cut for a hull that does not exist yet. They fit whichever one you choose.
